quote: The urgency of taking action has been reinforced by the 6th Assessment Report from the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), which anticipates that global warming could exceed 1.5ºC by as early as 2040 unless global greenhouse gas emissions are significantly reduced.
_rationale: By signing, CalPERS explicitly endorses IPCC-aligned science-based climate action, 1.5°C Paris Agreement goals, and net-zero transition commitments.

quote: the goal of the Paris Agreement to limit the global average temperature rise to no more than 1.5-degrees Celsius, which scientists say is necessary to avoid the worst impacts of climate change
